<!--
Element: Thumbnail-to-lightbox zoom
ID: 061 · Category: Cards & Content · Tags: lightbox, gallery, zoom, flip, swipe-dismiss
What it does: Press a photo and it grows from its thumbnail to fill the frame; close it and it shrinks back into place. In the viewer, double-click to zoom and drag around, swipe sideways to move between photos, or drag down to close.
How to use it: Press a photo to open it. Then try double-click to zoom, dragging sideways to switch and dragging down to close. With a keyboard, open with Enter, switch with the arrow keys and close with Esc
Footprint: fixed size, tall
Needs: tokens.css (the --ux-* theme tokens and the .ux base). Map the tokens to the project's theme variables.
Live demo: https://lucianlabs.dev/uxui-prompt/#061
-->
<style>
.u061{position:relative;width:340px;height:480px;border-radius:30px;background:var(--ux-surface);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ux-line),0 30px 60px -36px var(--ux-shadow-strong);overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.u061-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;padding:20px 20px 12px}
.u061-head b{font-size:19px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.u061-head small{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ux-ink-3)}
.u061-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-auto-rows:92px;gap:8px;padding:0 14px}
.u061-th{position:relative;border:0;padding:0;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ux-surface-2);transition:transform .35s var(--ux-spring),opacity .2s}
.u061-th:nth-child(1){grid-row:span 2}
.u061-th:nth-child(4),.u061-th:nth-child(5){grid-row:span 2}
.u061-th:hover{transform:scale(.97)}
.u061-th:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ux-accent);outline-offset:2px}
.u061-th.away{opacity:0}
.u061-th svg,.u061-img svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.u061-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;background:#07070C;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .45s}
.u061.is-open .u061-scrim{opacity:var(--so,1);pointer-events:auto}
.u061-view{position:absolute;z-index:6;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;touch-action:none}
.u061.is-open .u061-view{visibility:visible}
.u061-img{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:0 0;transition:transform .45s var(--ux-ease)}
.u061-img.now{transition:none}
.u061-ui{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.u061.is-open.is-ready .u061-ui{opacity:1}
.u061-x{position:absolute;right:14px;top:14px;width:42px;height:42px;border:0;padding:0;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);color:#fff;pointer-events:auto;transition:transform .3s var(--ux-spring)}
.u061-x:active{transform:scale(.88)}
.u061-x:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:2px}
.u061-x svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round}
.u061-cap{position:absolute;left:18px;right:18px;bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.u061-cap b{display:block;font-size:19px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.u061-cap small{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:650;opacity:.85}
.u061-cap em{font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.u061-zoom{position:absolute;left:50%;top:16px;transform:translateX(-50%);height:28px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:999px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.u061.is-zoom .u061-zoom{opacity:1}
</style>
<div class="ux u061">
  <div class="u061-head"><b>Jeju, 4 days</b><small>5 photos</small></div>
  <div class="u061-grid"></div>
  <div class="u061-scrim" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="u061-view" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Photo viewer" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="u061-img"></div>
    <div class="u061-ui"><span class="u061-zoom">2× zoom</span><button class="u061-x" type="button" aria-label="Close"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button><div class="u061-cap" aria-live="polite"><span><small></small><b></b></span><em></em></div></div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;
  var grid = root.querySelector('.u061-grid'), view = root.querySelector('.u061-view'), img = root.querySelector('.u061-img');
  var scrim = root.querySelector('.u061-scrim'), xBtn = root.querySelector('.u061-x'), cap = root.querySelector('.u061-cap');
  var rm = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var uid = 'u061' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
  var P = [
    ['Seongsan Peak', 'Day 1, morning', ['#FFB547', '#FF6B8B', '#3B2F9E'], 0],
    ['Hyeopjae Beach', 'Day 2, afternoon', ['#7DE3F0', '#22C3A6', '#0E5E63'], 1],
    ['Camellia trail', 'Day 2, evening', ['#FF9BA8', '#E5484D', '#5B1530'], 2],
    ['Hallasan ridge', 'Day 3, dawn', ['#B7A4FF', '#5B8CFF', '#1A1B4A'], 0],
    ['Tangerine farm café', 'Day 4, lunch', ['#FFE2B8', '#FFB547', '#D2702A'], 1]
  ];
  function art(p, k) {
    var g = uid + k + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5), c = p[2];
    return '<svg viewBox="0 0 300 400" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"><defs><linearGradient id="' + g + '" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="' + c[0] + '"/><stop offset=".6" stop-color="' + c[1] + '"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="' + c[2] + '"/></linearGradient></defs>' +
      '<rect width="300" height="400" fill="url(#' + g + ')"/><circle cx="' + (p[3] === 1 ? 80 : 210) + '" cy="150" r="46" fill="#fff" opacity=".55"/>' +
      '<path d="M0 270 C 70 220 130 250 190 230 S 270 210 300 240 V400 H0Z" fill="' + c[2] + '" opacity=".55"/>' +
      '<path d="M0 310 C 80 280 150 320 220 300 S 290 290 300 300 V400 H0Z" fill="' + c[2] + '" opacity=".85"/></svg>';
  }
  var ths = P.map(function (p, i) {
    var b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'u061-th'; b.type = 'button';
    b.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open ' + p[0]);
    b.innerHTML = art(p, 't' + i);
    b.addEventListener('click', function () { open(i); });
    grid.appendChild(b);
    return b;
  });
  var cur = -1, isOpen = false, z = 1, tx = 0, ty = 0;
  function rectOf(i) { var t = ths[i]; return { l: grid.offsetLeft + t.offsetLeft, t: grid.offsetTop + t.offsetTop, w: t.offsetWidth, h: t.offsetHeight }; }
  function caption() {
    cap.querySelector('small').textContent = P[cur][1];
    cap.querySelector('b').textContent = P[cur][0];
    cap.querySelector('em').textContent = (cur + 1) + ' / ' + P.length;
  }
  function setZoom(nz, ox, oy) {
    var W = view.clientWidth, H = view.clientHeight;
    if (nz > 1) { tx = Math.min(0, Math.max(W - W * nz, ox - (ox - tx) * nz / z)); ty = Math.min(0, Math.max(H - H * nz, oy - (oy - ty) * nz / z)); }
    else { tx = 0; ty = 0; }
    z = nz;
    img.style.transform = 'translate(' + tx + 'px,' + ty + 'px) scale(' + z + ')';
    root.classList.toggle('is-zoom', z > 1);
  }
  function morph(from, to, done) {
    var full = { l: 0, t: 0, w: root.clientWidth, h: root.clientHeight };
    var a = from || full, b = to || full;
    if (rm) { done && done(); return; }
    view.animate([
      { left: a.l + 'px', top: a.t + 'px', width: a.w + 'px', height: a.h + 'px', borderRadius: from ? '18px' : '30px' },
      { left: b.l + 'px', top: b.t + 'px', width: b.w + 'px', height: b.h + 'px', borderRadius: to ? '18px' : '30px' }
    ], { duration: 520, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)' }).onfinish = function () { done && done(); };
  }
  function open(i) {
    if (isOpen) return;
    isOpen = true; cur = i;
    img.innerHTML = art(P[i], 'v');
    setZoom(1);
    caption();
    root.classList.add('is-open');
    view.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    ths[i].classList.add('away');
    morph(rectOf(i), null, function () { root.classList.add('is-ready'); xBtn.focus({ preventScroll: true }); });
  }
  function close() {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    var i = cur;
    root.classList.remove('is-ready', 'is-zoom');
    setZoom(1);
    view.style.transform = '';
    root.style.removeProperty('--so');
    scrim.style.opacity = '0';
    morph(null, rectOf(i), function () {
      isOpen = false;
      root.classList.remove('is-open');
      scrim.style.opacity = '';
      view.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      ths[i].classList.remove('away');
      ths[i].focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }
  function go(d) {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    var n = (cur + d + P.length) % P.length;
    ths[cur].classList.remove('away');
    cur = n;
    ths[cur].classList.add('away');
    setZoom(1);
    var next = document.createElement('div');
    next.innerHTML = art(P[n], 'v');
    if (!rm) img.animate([{ transform: 'translateX(' + (d * 40) + 'px)', opacity: .2 }, { transform: 'none', opacity: 1 }], { duration: 420, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)' });
    img.innerHTML = next.innerHTML;
    caption();
  }
  xBtn.addEventListener('click', close);
  scrim.addEventListener('click', close);
  view.addEventListener('dblclick', function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest('button')) return;
    var r = view.getBoundingClientRect(), k = view.clientWidth / r.width;
    img.classList.remove('now');
    setZoom(z > 1 ? 1 : 2, (e.clientX - r.left) * k, (e.clientY - r.top) * k);
  });
  view.addEventListener('wheel', function (e) {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var r = view.getBoundingClientRect(), k = view.clientWidth / r.width;
    img.classList.add('now');
    setZoom(Math.max(1, Math.min(3, z * (e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.12 : 0.89))), (e.clientX - r.left) * k, (e.clientY - r.top) * k);
  }, { passive: false });
  var sx = 0, sy = 0, ox = 0, oy = 0, mode = '';
  view.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest('button') || !isOpen) return;
    sx = e.clientX; sy = e.clientY; ox = tx; oy = ty; mode = 'wait';
    view.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  view.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
    if (!mode) return;
    var r = view.getBoundingClientRect(), k = view.clientWidth / r.width;
    var dx = (e.clientX - sx) * k, dy = (e.clientY - sy) * k;
    if (mode === 'wait' && Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 6) mode = z > 1 ? 'pan' : Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) ? 'down' : 'side';
    if (mode === 'pan') {
      img.classList.add('now');
      var W = view.clientWidth, H = view.clientHeight;
      tx = Math.min(0, Math.max(W - W * z, ox + dx)); ty = Math.min(0, Math.max(H - H * z, oy + dy));
      img.style.transform = 'translate(' + tx + 'px,' + ty + 'px) scale(' + z + ')';
    } else if (mode === 'down') {
      var d = Math.max(0, dy);
      view.style.transform = 'translateY(' + d + 'px) scale(' + (1 - d / 1600) + ')';
      root.style.setProperty('--so', Math.max(0.2, 1 - d / 300).toFixed(2));
    } else if (mode === 'side') {
      img.classList.add('now');
      img.style.transform = 'translateX(' + dx * 0.5 + 'px)';
    }
  });
  function up(e) {
    if (!mode) return;
    var r = view.getBoundingClientRect(), k = view.clientWidth / r.width;
    var dx = (e.clientX - sx) * k, dy = (e.clientY - sy) * k, m = mode;
    mode = '';
    img.classList.remove('now');
    if (m === 'down') {
      if (dy > 110) { close(); return; }
      view.style.transition = 'transform .4s cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.64,1)';
      view.style.transform = '';
      root.style.removeProperty('--so');
      setTimeout(function () { view.style.transition = ''; }, 420);
    } else if (m === 'side') {
      img.style.transform = '';
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 70) go(dx < 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }
  }
  view.addEventListener('pointerup', up);
  view.addEventListener('pointercancel', up);
  root.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); close(); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); go(1); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); go(-1); }
    else if (e.key === 'Tab') { e.preventDefault(); xBtn.focus(); }
  });
})();
</script>
